error: MALLET returned a foreign or duplicate vocabulary

diagnosis.cause: Python Unicode IGNORECASE admitted the dotless-i token ıve despite the declared ASCII tokenizer, while MALLET's [a-z0-9]+ tokenizer correctly emitted ve.
diagnosis.correction: Apply re.ASCII together with re.IGNORECASE in both build and consultation tokenizers so the Python and Java vocabularies implement the declared ascii-alphanumeric-v1 contract.
